analysis_daily_hint: Tap a bar to see the day
analysis_daily_period: All history · swipe to see past days
analysis_no_data: Not enough data yet. Keep logging your days.
analysis_symptoms_compare: Days affected · change vs the previous {1} days
backup_export_desc: Encrypted file, protected by a password
backup_export_done: Backup saved. Keep the password somewhere safe.
backup_export_failed: The backup could not be saved.
backup_export_message: The file is encrypted with this password. You will need it to import the file.
backup_import_desc: Encrypted backup, or an older unencrypted export
backup_import_failed: Import failed: the file could not be read. Your data was not changed.
backup_import_message: Enter the password chosen when this file was exported. Importing replaces the data currently in the app.
backup_import_unrecognized: This file is not an IBD Journal backup. Nothing was imported.
backup_import_wrong_password: Wrong password, or the file is damaged.
backup_password_warning: If you forget this password, the file cannot be recovered. Nobody can open it without the password.
calendar_privacy_message: The names of your treatments and exams will be written into your phone calendar. This calendar may be synchronized with an online account (Google, Samsung, Outlook…) and then leave your phone. Choose a local calendar that is not synchronized (phone calendar) if you want this information to stay on the phone.
calendar_privacy_note: Treatment and exam names are written into this calendar. If it is synchronized with an online account, they leave the phone: prefer a local phone calendar that is not synchronized.
daily_reminder_desc: Get a notification to log your stools, pain and fatigue
exam_preparation_desc: Note your doctor's or endoscopy center's instructions.
exam_reminder_anesthesia: Today at {1}, before your exam on {2}.
exam_reminder_diet: Start the low-residue diet today, until your exam on {1}.
exam_reminder_exam: Today at {1}. Remember to bring your prescription and ID.
exam_reminder_prep: Time to drink your bowel preparation, for your exam on {1}.
exam_reminders_desc: {1} h before appointments, at the time of each prep dose, and at {2} on the first diet day.
exams_empty: No exam scheduled. Add your colonoscopy or sigmoidoscopy to note its preparation and get reminders.
false_urge_hint: Urge to go without passing stool, sometimes with blood or mucus.
history_legend_note: Green = normal stools · orange = loose or watery
home_empty: Nothing logged yet. Tap an action above.
lab_import_all_nothing: None of the tracked tests was found in these documents.
lab_import_check_reports: Values read from your reports. Check each one against the document before saving.
lab_import_document_failed: This document could not be read: only PDFs from the lab that contain text are supported (not scanned documents). Enter the values by hand.
lab_import_document_nothing: No tracked test found in this document.
lab_import_duplicate_in_import: Already in another report for this date
lab_import_no_date: Sample date not found: check it.
lab_result_reference_desc: As printed on the lab report, in the same unit.
meal_description_hint: What are you eating? (foods, amounts, symptoms…)
no_photo: No meal logged for this time.
onboarding_disclaimer: Your data stays on your device and is not a substitute for medical advice.
onboarding_profile_text: These details appear on your report for the doctor. They stay on your phone and can be changed in Settings.
onboarding_text: This daily diary helps you track your diet and bowel movements if you live with ulcerative colitis or Crohn's disease. Attach photos or barcodes to your meals, and log each stool with a comment, so you can discuss it in more detail with your doctor.
onboarding_tour_care_text: Your treatments are there. You can also schedule blood tests and stool tests (calprotectin) with a reminder on the right day, and keep your lab results, typed in or imported from a lab report.
onboarding_tour_history_text: The calendar colors each day: green for normal stools, orange for loose or watery ones. Tap a day to see and edit what you logged.
onboarding_tour_history_title: History: your month at a glance
onboarding_tour_today_text: Tap “Stool”, pick the Bristol type, from hard (1) to watery (7), and save. Add blood, mucus, pain or fatigue when needed. Log your meals with a photo or by scanning a barcode.
onboarding_tour_trends_text: The chart shows your stools day by day, with a red dot when blood is reported. Compare the last 30 days, 90 days or your whole history, and count the days with symptoms.
onboarding_tour_trends_title: Trends: see how you are doing
onboarding_treatments_empty: No treatment yet. You can also add them later in the Care tab.
onboarding_treatments_text: Add the medications you take, from the list or by typing their name. Each one can have a reminder: daily, every 2 weeks, monthly…
product_not_found: Product not found in the Open Food Facts database
refill_alert_label: Remind me {1} days before to order
refill_hint_dose: The alert comes {1} days before each dose.
refill_hint_stock: The alert comes {1} days before this date. Update it each time you renew your treatment.
reminder_enabled_desc: Get a notification at the scheduled time
report_adherence: Adherence over the period: {1} of planned doses confirmed taken ({2} of {3}) · missed: {4} · no answer: {5}
report_adherence_none: No dose confirmed in the app over this period
report_error: The report could not be created. Please try again.
report_footer: Data entered by the patient — does not replace medical advice
report_labs_legend: ↑ above · ↓ below (in bold): outside the lab's reference values as entered; – when none were given.
report_no_data: No stool logged over this period.
report_summary_note: Type 0 entries (no stool) are not counted as stools. Per-day averages use the days with at least one stool entry.
scan_hint: Place the product barcode inside the frame
swipe_hint: Swipe horizontally to change the view
treatment_other_desc: Not in the list? Type its name.
web_backup_import_desc: Encrypted backup file (.ibdj) from the Android app or another browser. It replaces the data currently in the app.
web_backup_reminder_text: Your data is stored only in this browser. Clearing the site data, or the browser itself, erases it. Export an encrypted backup regularly and keep it somewhere safe.
web_care_notif_needed: Notification permission has not been granted: reminders will not pop up while the app is open.
web_chart_desc: Stools per day from {1} to {2}: {3} stools in total, at most {4} in one day, blood reported on {5} days.
web_chart_show_table: Show the data as a table
web_delta_less: {1} fewer days than the previous period
web_delta_more: {1} more days than the previous period
web_evening_reminder_desc: Shows the evening check-in (stool type, pain, fatigue) and a notification while the app is open
web_export_ics_desc: Treatments, checkups and exam steps as calendar events with their alert. Repeat the export after any change. Everything stays on your device until you import the file.
web_export_ics_empty: Nothing to export: no treatment, checkup or exam is scheduled.
web_footer_license: Free software under the AGPL-3.0 licence
web_ics_privacy_message: The names of your treatments and exams will be written in the calendar file. If you import it into a calendar synchronized with an online account (Google, Apple, Outlook…), this information leaves this device. Import it into a local calendar that is not synchronized if you want it to stay here.
web_install_desc: Install IBD Journal on this device to open it like an app, even offline.
web_install_unavailable: Installation is not offered by this browser. Look for "Install" or "Add to Home Screen" in the browser menu.
web_lab_chart_hollow: Hollow point: result given as a threshold (< or >)
web_lab_date_invalid: Enter a date that is not in the future
web_lab_import_privacy: The PDF files are read in your browser. They are never uploaded.
web_lab_table_caption: Lab results by collection date, most recent on the left
web_medical_text: IBD Journal is a personal journal. It records and displays what you enter; it does not interpret your results or suggest any medical decision, and it is not a medical device. It does not replace medical advice: always follow your doctor's instructions, especially for exam preparation and treatments.
web_not_found_text: This page does not exist or has moved.
web_notif_denied: Notifications are blocked in your browser settings.
web_notif_desc: Notifications are shown only while this tab or the installed app is open. To be reminded when it is closed, add the events to your calendar with the .ics export.
web_notif_title: Reminders while the app is open
web_notif_unsupported: This browser does not support notifications.
web_onboarding_reminders_text: Each day, the Today screen shows an evening check-in card and what is due. While the app is open, it can also send you a notification. To be reminded when it is closed, export your treatments and exams to your calendar from Settings. You can change the time in Settings.
web_onboarding_restore_hint: Already using IBD Journal on your phone or in another browser? Restore an encrypted backup (.ibdj) now.
web_photo_error: This image could not be read. Try another photo.
web_print_hint: Use your browser's print dialog, then choose "Save as PDF" as the destination.
web_privacy_text: Your journal, treatments and lab results are stored only in this browser, on this device. There is no account, no server holding your data, no analytics and no cookies. The only network request is the barcode lookup on Open Food Facts, which receives the barcode alone. Backups are encrypted with a password you choose, and nothing leaves your device unless you export it.
web_repeat_every_invalid: Enter a whole number between 1 and 365.
web_report_note: The report is generated on this device from the data you entered. It interprets nothing.
web_restore_confirm_check: I understand that importing replaces all the data currently stored in this browser.
web_scan_camera_denied: Camera access was refused. Allow the camera for this site in your browser settings, or type the barcode below.
web_scan_camera_unavailable: The camera cannot be used here. Type the barcode below.
web_scan_manual_hint: The 8 to 14 digits printed under the barcode.
web_scan_privacy: The camera image never leaves your device. Only the barcode number is sent to Open Food Facts to find the product.
web_source_code_desc: IBD Journal is free software (AGPL-3.0). View and download the source code.
